properties.description: Extraccion del journal de negocio (Sybase journal.dbo.jen) - movimientos Interbancarios (jen_ope_evt LIKE 'IB%'), fecha = FechaProceso - 7 dias. Escribe archivo plano *_JOURNAL_JEN_IBM.TXT. Migracion del Server Job J990_Jen_Extraccion_IB.

SelectList.defaultValue: SELECT REPLACE(jen_ope_evt,'|',' ') AS jen_ope_evt, jen_fec_evt_neg, jen_fec_ctb_evt, REPLACE(jen_rut_cli,'|',' ') AS jen_rut_cli, REPLACE(jen_vrf_cli,'|',' ') AS jen_vrf_cli, REPLACE(jen_rut_emp,'|',' ') AS jen_rut_emp, REPLACE(jen_vrf_emp,'|',' ') AS jen_vrf_emp, REPLACE(jen_id_cnl,'|',' ') AS jen_id_cnl, REPLACE(jen_est_cnl,'|',' ') AS jen_est_cnl, REPLACE(jen_suc_ori,'|',' ') AS jen_suc_ori, REPLACE(jen_med,'|',' ') AS jen_med, REPLACE(jen_id_med,'|',' ') AS jen_id_med, REPLACE(jen_tip_opr_bci,'|',' ') AS jen_tip_opr_bci, REPLACE(jen_id_opr,'|',' ') AS jen_id_opr, REPLACE(jen_mod_tar,'|',' ') AS jen_mod_tar, REPLACE(jen_fra_lin,'|',' ') AS jen_fra_lin, REPLACE(jen_ara_cua,'|',' ') AS jen_ara_cua, REPLACE(jen_id_svs,'|',' ') AS jen_id_svs, REPLACE(jen_est_evt_neg,'|',' ') AS jen_est_evt_neg, REPLACE(jen_id_pdt,'|',' ') AS jen_id_pdt, REPLACE(jen_id_evt,'|',' ') AS jen_id_evt, REPLACE(jen_id_sub_evt,'|',' ') AS jen_id_sub_evt, REPLACE(jen_clv_ppl,'|',' ') AS jen_clv_ppl, jen_mto, REPLACE(jen_clv_sgd,'|',' ') AS jen_clv_sgd, REPLACE(jen_cpo_var,'|',' ') AS jen_cpo_var

activities.name: Copy_Jen_IB
activities.description: Sybase ODBC -> archivo plano IBM. REPLACE('|',' ') reproduce el EREPLACE del Transformer DataStage. Ver gaps: validar normalizacion de no-imprimibles (ICONV 'MCP').

query.value: @concat(pipeline().parameters.SelectList, ' FROM ', pipeline().parameters.DBO_Journal, '.jen WHERE CAST(jen_fec_evt_neg AS DATE)=dateadd(day,-7,CAST(''', pipeline().parameters.FechaProceso, ''' AS DATE)) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt,1,2)=''IB''')
